title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Foundation Work Item
summary: Add the first DoQ adapter foundation without moving DNS semantics into the QUIC transport runtime.
planned_changes:
- Add `Incursa.Quic.Dns` to the solution as the DoQ adapter package.
- Add RFC 9250 defaults for ALPN `doq`, UDP port 853, and UDP port 53 rejection.
- Add DoQ error-code constants for the registered RFC 9250 values.
- Add a span-oriented codec for the two-octet DNS message length prefix.
- Add focused tests and requirement-home trace proof for the foundation slice.
verification_plan: Run a focused build for the new DoQ package, run DoQ foundation and RFC 9250 requirement-home tests, validate core SpecTrace JSON artifacts, and confirm diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: DNS parser, resolver, cache, recursive resolver, or authoritative server behavior.
DoQ cancellation/reset policy beyond error-code constants.
DoQ padding policy, connection reuse, AXFR/IXFR, 0-RTT, Retry/address validation, and external interop proof.
completion_notes: The foundation package creates the stable constants and framing surface needed by later DoQ stream-adapter work.
